title: Derived etale clopen mate normalization data
statement: Let $\Lambda:\mathrm{Type}(u+1)$ be a commutative ring and let $V,W,S,T:\mathrm{Scheme}_u$. Let $k:V\hookrightarrow W$ and $i:S\hookrightarrow T$ be open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion], let $r:V\to S$ and $p:W\to T$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $pk=ir$. Put $W_S=W\times_T S$ with projections $b,q$ and lift $s=(k,r)$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. On small etale module sheaves and their bounded-below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], write $G_f=f^{-1}$ for exact inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], $R_f=Rf_*$ for derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and $J_j=j_!$ for exact extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Define $\alpha_Q:G_pJ_i\to J_kG_r$ by exact localization of the inverse cartesian open-unit comparison $G_pJ_i\to J_bG_q$, followed by $J_b\pi_sG_q$ and the open/pullback compositors. Here $\pi_s:\mathrm{id}\to s_!s^{-1}$ is the direct-image unit followed by the inverse of the canonical support inclusion $s_!\to s_*$; it is identity on the clopen image of $s$ and zero on its complement. Define $\gamma_Q:J_iR_r\to R_pJ_k$ as the proper-adjunction mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of this actual $\alpha_Q$. These are the existing bounded-below transformations `derivedAlphaPlus` and `derivedMatePlus`. When $\Lambda$ is finite, define $\delta_Q:J_iR_r\xrightarrow{\sim}R_pJ_k$ to be the named comparison `normalizedComparison` selected from [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence], whose resolution and derived-unit normalization determines it. This definition records the specified transformations and comparison; their equality is the separate etale normalization theorem.

def derivedAlphaPlus {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S)
    (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) :
    (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⟶
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k).mapDerivedCategoryPlus
